column1: # comment: "Provenance + import-provenance alignments. The core PROV-O anchors (Activity, wasDerivedFrom, wasGeneratedBy, wasAttributedTo) and the carrier/ingestion terms align to PROV-O and Dublin Core Terms. recordedNoLaterThan and contentDigest are canonical \u2014 no faithful external term models a derived terminus-ante-quem or a content-addressed carrier digest."

column6: the general provenance-activity class, co-extensive with prov:Activity; the narrower activity kinds (Event, ObservationalActivity, ImportActivity, ...) map in by closeMatch/relatedMatch
Source-hood is anti-rigid; the described thing is a CreativeWork (WEMI).

prov:generated links an activity to the entity it generated; gmeow:generatedObservation specialises the range to Observation. The ObservationalActivity→prov:Activity alignment is canonical in mapping-dsl/equivalences/events.ttl (eqEvents132).
